findings.evidence: 126 pre-existing items plus 11 Phase 12.17.5C evidence files are untracked; 126/126 were exhaustively classified.
findings.attack_or_failure_scenario: A clean clone or release omits decisions, evidence and an architecture guard that exist only in the local worktree.
findings.impact: Serious provenance and release reproducibility gap; no runtime exploit.
findings.local_single_user_context: Reduces external attack likelihood but not loss-on-clone or incomplete-release risk.
findings.existing_mitigation: Files are preserved locally and the complete 126-item register records their identities.
findings.gap: No owner-approved consolidation/disposition exists for these untracked files.

findings.evidence: Failure-isolated sinks are instantiated only in tests; calibration defaults to NullCalibrationTelemetrySink; no startup/shutdown composition exists.
findings.attack_or_failure_scenario: A local startup, migration, provider or recovery failure leaves insufficient durable diagnostic evidence.
findings.impact: Operational diagnosis and incident reconstruction are incomplete.
findings.local_single_user_context: Limits audience but does not remove supportability and auditability needs.
findings.existing_mitigation: Structured, bounded and privacy-aware contracts and wrappers are already tested.
findings.gap: No destination, rotation, retention, startup/shutdown or flush policy is selected and wired.

findings.evidence: No HTTP server, routes, bind, port, CORS, origin, debug, headers or host policy exists.
findings.attack_or_failure_scenario: A future server could default to a non-loopback bind or permissive browser policy without a prior invariant test.
findings.impact: Potential LAN exposure or cross-origin invocation after HTTP materialization.
findings.local_single_user_context: Current risk is zero because no server exists; future local-browser exposure remains relevant.
findings.existing_mitigation: No HTTP attack surface exists today.
findings.gap: The LOCAL_BROWSER/LOOPBACK_ONLY_BY_DEFAULT target is not encoded.

findings.evidence: SandboxFilesystemPort explicitly has no implementation; materialization_export is structural only.
findings.attack_or_failure_scenario: An eventual adapter could mishandle junctions, TOCTOU or atomic publication despite safe contract-level metadata.
findings.impact: Unauthorized local file read/write or overwrite if implemented without equivalent physical guards.
findings.local_single_user_context: Local scope lowers blast radius but user documents remain valuable.
findings.existing_mitigation: Strict relative-path, extension, MIME, size, symlink and post-output policies.
findings.gap: No concrete resolver/inspector proves physical containment and safe publication.

findings.evidence: Runtime/index/backup parents use mkdir and ordinary opens without explicit ACL/umask/owner verification or no-follow checks.
findings.attack_or_failure_scenario: A hostile local filesystem entry redirects a runtime/index path or inherited permissions expose local data.
findings.impact: Local data disclosure or corruption; authenticated seed and fresh-target controls limit the scenario.
findings.local_single_user_context: Requires local filesystem influence, materially reducing likelihood.
findings.existing_mitigation: Absolute resolved paths, seed/runtime distinctness, fresh-target semantics, hashes, atomic replace and seed snapshots.
findings.gap: No explicit least-privilege permission and no-follow policy at the concrete file boundary.

findings.evidence: Only pyproject.toml and requirements-dev.txt exist; runtime/extra dependencies are major-bounded but no lockfile or hashes exist.
findings.attack_or_failure_scenario: Two installations resolve different transitive versions or acquire a newly published incompatible package.
findings.impact: Reproducibility and supply-chain assurance are weaker than the canonical baseline requires.
findings.local_single_user_context: Does not prevent dependency drift during local install or CI.
findings.existing_mitigation: Python minor range, provider SDK major bounds and exact dev dependency versions.
findings.gap: No resolved lock and no artifact hashes.

findings.evidence: 3,134 files exist under .tmp, 44 under tool cache roots and 747 generated files under artifacts; a previous global run was contaminated by in-repo temp fixtures.
findings.attack_or_failure_scenario: Repository-walking tests consume nested temp copies and produce false failures, slow scans or misleading evidence.
findings.impact: Non-deterministic validation and local storage growth; files remain outside Git.
findings.local_single_user_context: This is primarily a local correctness and hygiene risk.
findings.existing_mitigation: Roots are ignored and the authoritative tests can use the system temp directory.
findings.gap: No bounded cleanup/retention procedure and repository-walk exclusion contract is documented.

findings.evidence: git check-ignore does not match generic backup, *.tmp, *.building or *.jsonl files outside dedicated roots.
findings.attack_or_failure_scenario: A generated backup, build-temporary index or structured log placed adjacent to a configured DB appears as an untracked candidate.
findings.impact: Accidental staging risk, mitigated by review discipline.
findings.existing_mitigation: Default data roots are outside the repository and dedicated local roots are ignored.
findings.gap: Four generated-file families lack defensive patterns.

findings.evidence: Legacy SQLite environment aliases remain active although the source comment says they are retained until B08.
findings.attack_or_failure_scenario: Operators retain two naming systems, increasing configuration ambiguity and documentation drift.
findings.impact: Low because divergent duplicate values fail closed.
findings.existing_mitigation: New and legacy values must resolve equivalently or configuration fails closed.
findings.gap: Compatibility exit criteria were not applied or re-documented.

findings.evidence: ENVIRONMENT.md states that OpenAI is the sole direct runtime dependency and does not mention the optional Anthropic calibration extra.
findings.attack_or_failure_scenario: A maintainer prepares an incomplete calibration environment or misclassifies Anthropic as transitive/test-only.
findings.existing_mitigation: pyproject.toml accurately declares the optional dependency.
findings.gap: Environment documentation is incomplete for calibration tooling.
